personalInfo.name: Ari Syahputra, S.Kom
personalInfo.title: Full Stack Developer
personalInfo.bio: I am a Web Developer with a passion and expertise in website development, specifically in building modern, responsive, and functional web applications. I have experience working with various web technologies, including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, MySQL, and the Laravel framework.

projects.title: Classification of Stunted Toddlers
projects.description: A web-based application designed to help monitor and classify stunting conditions in toddlers. This system allows users to manage toddler data, record growth measurements such as age, weight, and height, and generate stunting classification results. It also provides a dashboard to manage training data, view prediction results, and monitor toddler growth information efficiently. The application aims to support data-driven monitoring and early identification of potential stunting cases.

projects.title: Graduate Student Room – Booking Requirements for Thesis Defense
projects.description: A web-based booking system designed to simplify the ordering and reservation of graduation and thesis defense equipment. This application allows students to browse available graduation supplies, select the required items, and place orders for their thesis defense and graduation ceremonies. It also helps administrators manage product data, monitor orders, and organize reservations efficiently. The system aims to make the ordering process more convenient, structured, and accessible for students.

projects.title: Classification of Stroke
projects.description: A web-based application developed to classify the risk of stroke using the C5.0 decision tree algorithm. The system allows users to input patient health data, such as age, gender, hypertension status, heart disease history, glucose level, and other relevant factors to generate stroke classification results. It also provides features for managing training data, performing data classification, and displaying prediction results. The application aims to support early stroke risk assessment through a data-driven classification process.

projects.title: FashionRakyat
projects.description: FashionRakyat is a straightforward e-commerce platform built using Laravel 13 and Bootstrap 5, designed to help small-scale businesses (MSMEs) in the clothing, trousers, and footwear sectors sell their products online without the need for a complex system. The platform features two distinct interfaces: a customer-facing side—accessible without requiring a login—for viewing catalogs and placing orders, and an admin side—protected by a login system—for managing products and orders. Each product supports size variants (such as S/M/L or 39/40/41) with stock tracking for every individual size, ensuring that customers can accurately select from the available options.

education.description: I am an Informatics Engineering graduate from Malikussaleh University, with a focus on information technology and software development. During my studies, I delved into various aspects of programming, website development, databases, as well as the analysis and implementation of algorithms. This education has helped me build a strong foundation in the field of technology and web-based application development.

Throughout my studies, I developed technical skills, creativity, and problem-solving abilities within the process of producing digital work.
